## Problem

The #593 hold (PR #619) holds the dependents of an unpublished bundle, but follows only `waves.declared_deps` (`Depends on` / `Depends on (merged)` / `Stacks on`; `template/src/pdca_harness/flow.py:705` on branch `fix/593-stack-mode-append-only-fold-real-base-prs`). `compute_waves` also puts a `Conflicts with` pair into separate waves (`waves.py:177`), so the second bundle builds *on* the first.

Failing case (reproduced through `flow.flow_ids` by the round-2 adversary review): wave 0 = {CA}, whose publish fails. Wave 1 = {CJ}, with `Conflicts with: CA`. CA is left out of the fold, and CJ is **not** held: it is built and published on a base without CA, though the two edit the same resource. When CA is later published by hand, the two PRs collide on the target. Before #593 the fold carried CA's patch, so CJ was built on it.

The round-2 sign-off put this "out of scope this round (brief unchanged)"; it was never picked up.

## Done when

Decide whether a `Conflicts with` partner of an unpublished bundle is held like a dependent. If yes, a flow test pins the CA/CJ case (CJ held and named). If no, document why in `docs/07-crosscutting.md` next to the hold.

Found by the eduralph/pdca-pdca Act review of 2026-10-02 (issue_593 iteration-v2 adversary review + sign-off delta).
title: stack mode: a Conflicts-with partner of an unpublished bundle is not held, so it builds on a line without it
